# The creation of Spider-Man

Spider-Man was created by writer Stan Lee and artist Steve Ditko. He first appeared in Amazing Fantasy #15 in 1962, the final issue of a series that was about to be cancelled.

The character was unusual because Peter Parker was a teenager with everyday problems: money, school and family. Most heroes of the time were adults, and teenagers usually appeared only as sidekicks.

Spider-Man proved so popular that he received his own series, The Amazing Spider-Man, in 1963. His guiding idea, that great power comes with great responsibility, became one of the best-known themes in comics.
